name: 34201 · University Pk, FL
findings: ZIP 34201 (University Pk) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34201 (University Pk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34201 (University Pk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
